report:
Reviewed the complete literal_syntax claim and all ordinary evidence. The spec.rs association implements the required exclusions: parse_anchors processes definitions only in text outside code/HTML and enclosing tags, skips escaped markers, obtains headings from Markdown events, and accepts standalone explicit end comments only as complete HTML blocks outside enclosing elements. update_anchor_html_tags preserves nested/multiline and quoted tags across blank lines and handles raw-text closing elements; inline code supplies no definition events. Thus examples neither open nor close claims, while a real standalone marker outside them remains a boundary.

All five associated tests contain meaningful assertions: boundary_examples_in_code_escapes_and_enclosing_html_are_literal asserts exact retained claim text and exactly two real anchors, and no anchors/diagnostics for examples alone, covering fenced/indented/inline code, escapes, headings, nested/multiline/inline HTML and comments. malformed_looking_comments_are_content_and_do_not_end_claims asserts exact preservation of nonstandalone/malformed/multiline comments. raw_html_text_does_not_hide_boundaries_after_its_closing_element verifies retained HTML and the following independent claim for script/style/textarea/pre/div. rendering_removes_only_parsed_end_markers checks both render paths preserve literal examples, remove precisely one true marker, and preserve outside prose. prose_rendering_hides_control_comments_but_preserves_literal_examples asserts three escaped literal markers including inline/fenced/enclosed HTML, with the control comment removed. Captured setup helpers and browser rendering context corroborate these assertions; the boundary algorithm itself is entirely in the associated spec.rs source. No TODO/N/A entries or deferred prerequisites exist.

Baseline verification: exact-byte comparison independently confirmed spec.rs implementation and browser.rs test source match historical inputs. The sole spec.rs test-file delta switches an unrelated modeled-claim snapshot assertion from claim to a selected claim fragment; associated tests are unchanged. Prior rationale remains sufficient after this claim-specific reassessment. Source inspection and start/read/record commands were performed; I did not run behavior tests or a build. The coordinator's reported 321 passing functional tests and successful root build are separate execution evidence, not my execution. No source edits or requested changes.
